entities.summary: Nil Montserrat Simó is a Spanish racing driver and coach. He has competed in such series as Formula Renault 3.5 Series and the European F3 Open Championship. In 2017, his namesake NM Racing team were the overall winners at 24 Hours of Barcelona.
